notes.title: Development Announcement
notes.notes:
We, from Monoceros Beetle, are sorry for the delays on the development of Master of the Wizards. The updates are taking more time to be done than we previously thought, but that doesn't mean we've quit the project! We are preparing an update with some most requested features, such as Signature Spells and the addition of sound effects, to be launched soon.

So please, stay with us to check out those new improvements!
Thank you so much for your patience!

Monoceros Beetle.

notes.title: Land Spotlight!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/5596500e2a233a2d87fa7ffdbbc6d2b4d64747c0.png[/img]

“The shape of the world is a great mystery that is fiercely debated among sages, scholars, and random peasants. Some argue that it is flat like a disc, while others say it’s a sphere, and others still say it’s shaped like a doughnut. In any case, it is certain that there’s a place where the world ends, and this great and ancestral fortress is proof of this. What lies beyond it’s gates? Nobody knows. Whoever went to the other side never came back… and who did come back, uttered only gibberish.”

Sometimes it’s very risky to cast all your spells and empty your hand. You never know when you’ll need a Chain Spell to avoid a massive damage that could take you out of the competition. But it may give you an upper hand if the End of the World Gates Fortress is at play, because that is one of the ways to spread your influence to it. As the end of the world means it’s terminus, to own this card also helps with secrets to destroy other lands more easily.

At the front layer, rises the first fortress’s wall that protects the End of the World Gates. Passing it, a stairway leads to an old and unsuspecting wooden door: the gate itself! For some reason, it is slightly open, projecting an eerie pink light. At the background, over the tall stone walls, a chaotic and cosmic storm give us a clue of the kind of uncanny and mysterious events beyond our knowledge.

notes.title: Land Spotlight!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/322016dd1bc6270ba62a4bcf4e2e67a2b14dd39f.png[/img]

“It has been said that philosophers might be the most suitable for ruling positions. Curiously, it’s usually philosophers who say that… This kingdom took that advice to heart, and not only does it have a philosopher king, it has lots of them. They spend most of their time discussing among themselves about ethics, meta-physics, and other such nonsense, thus leaving their subjects alone and leading to great prosperity in the kingdom. They are able to recognize great threats though, and will seek alliances with powerful wizards in order to protect their people.”

At a point in some matches, land devastation can be a very common and fun thing to do, so we wanted a land that would interact with other land being destroyed, and Majestic Kingdom of the Wiser Kings was born! This land gives advantage to land devastation and the concept behind it is that, seeing a powerful wizard simply annihilating lands left and right, the wise kings would “befriend” this wizard, believing that this association would free them from this spellcaster wrath.

Through the arched gates of the first layer, a small stairway full of city rulers is displayed at the second layer. Two wise kings play chess and one of them is visibly perplexed, thinking about his next play. Another king is just loafing around while an elvish queen stylishly reads a book. Two other governors debate about a thesis written on a tome and an outraged queen puzzles herself with a unknown artifact. At the background layer is possible to look at the outer walls of the city and a calm blue sky.

notes.title: Land Spotlight!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/2d82e99d4d9e2893068e2798fe9b98a477fa62f0.png[/img]


"Far to the northern regions, where the howling frost winds make even the rocks crack, the rough barbarians shrug it off like it's nothing. When they are not raiding and pillaging, they like to do feats of strength to show off their incredible might, like lifting longships, anvil throwing, getting hit by horse kicks without passing out and wrestling polar bears. Those who survive all such trials are deemed the worthiest warriors of their tribe."

Virtually at every match, tons of damages are distributed around among the wizards, so we decided to give those poor souls some "advantages" when taking too much damage at once: they would draw attention of the self proclaimed manliest men around the world: the Tough Northern Barbarians. They applaud those who can endure great pain and let be influenced by a powerful wizard thar shares this common trait with them.

At the gates of the village, on the first layer, a strong warrior wrestles a polar bear, keeping it in a rear choke hold. Although this scene seems cruel, they are just old sparring partners. At the middle layer, another northern barbarian shows off his strength by proudly lifting an anvil, whilst two other guys fight each other just to prove how is the mightier. At the back layer, it begins the borders of the forest and is possible to see an ship left around, probably dragged by another warrior eager to show a feat of strength.

notes.title: Small Update - Patch 0.19.4
notes.notes:
• Each Wizard now has their own personality parameters for AI.

• AI Wizards are now randomized.

• AI Wizards now are able to take over certain Lands by paying their alt-cost.

• The Language menu will be shown only when there's more than one language option.

• Our ink-soaked goblins have toiled to create some more pretty pictures for the Land Cards.

• Vaporized a bug where the appearance of Axl would leave AI Wizards babbling and confused, unable to cast spells.

notes.title: Small Update - Patch 0.19.3
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

• Devastated a bug that caused the AIs to compulsively put the Lands to waste.

• Smashed with a book a bug where a Wizard taking too much time with their Unstoppable Research could become lost forever.

notes.title: Small Update - Patch 0.19.2
notes.notes:
[h2]Tweaks[/h2]

• You can now set the amount of players in a game in both single player and LAN modes.
• A dead Wizard is not required to acknowledge cast spells by pressing "Continue" anymore.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

• Squashed a bug where divisions by zero could make the AIs go even more crazy.
• Eliminated a bug where a reference to something that shouldn't not exist could break the time-continuum.
• Zapped a bug where a Wizard could exploit the passage of time to get away with more Spells than they should.
• Banished a bug where summoning the mighty Kraken with less than 8 Lands in game could cause it to be way more disastrous than it's ever supposed to be.

notes.title: Small Update - Patch 0.19
notes.notes:
[b]• Added a Tutorial Mode.[/b]

Now you can try the Tutorial for Master of the Wizards! To show you the rules and how the game works, we summoned Axl, a transmutated wizard that knows about everything in Master of the Wizards, but don't have enough power to compete for the title. This little fellow will accompany you in a small match to clarify how some Spells, Lands and Resources work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044235/02e5fa5ba1d8303a9bbc9072e52de380d0e23ae9.png[/img]

Hope you have fun trying to be the next Master of the Wizards!

notes.title: Master of the Wizards is now available in Early Access
notes.notes:
[h1]Today is the day! Gather your spellbooks and potions and be the next Master of the Wizards![/h1]

Fight your rivals in chaotic and fun battles for fame and glory to ascend to the throne and conquer the title of Master of the Wizards!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1721010/Master_of_the_Wizards/

[h1]Watch the trailer[/h1]
[previewyoutube=XOGp75HNHCE;full][/previewyoutube]

In the early access version, you can play against the AI and against your friends via LAN!

[h2]Chose your wizard![/h2]
Master of the Wizards is a party card game for 4 to 6 players in which you control a respectable wizard, you can choose one of our six characters to be your avatar.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/25a7cc937eb4d12f99f709fb2180ab36372af72c.png[/img]

[h2]Conquer strange lands![/h2]
Conquer Lands to gain influence throughout the realms and some extra power. Reach 20 points of influence to win the game.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/875d03d0f3c14e7d5fdd53a024683bc3ae4836a0.png[/img]

[h2]Cast powerful spells![/h2]
Target other Wizards with your mighty Attack Spells. Be the last Wizard standing to win the game. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/1a2c36e3c33ec152755a810f908222c9bda12176.png[/img]

[h2]Buff yourself![/h2]
Increase your power with Buff Spells to get the upper hand.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/22c1fa607d9c8b13ba7683d2efbee1fc0b9b2dba.png[/img]

[h2]Curse your rivals![/h2]
Cast Curse Spells upon rival Wizards to make their life miserable.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/6fb33674013ad8e20ef8d262c4cb6615e4cda4cb.png[/img]

[h2]And Chain their spells right back at them![/h2]
Answer your enemies' attacks with Chain Spells to make them someone else's problem... But beware of being a Chain target yourself!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/ca5908fc98f9f1e87dc29cf70949edad351d9625.png[/img]

notes.title: Wizard Spotlight: The Summoner
notes.notes:
[h1]Nyanko, The Summoner[/h1]

Bounded with cute magical creatures, friendly and kind elementals and  unspeakable horrors of dark dimensions, she uses all her summons to fight by her side, whether they like it or not. Don't be fooled by her apparent sweetness, for her cruelty is inversely proportional to her size.

[h2]Likes[/h2]
Compelling power, cute creatures, cartoons

[h2]Dislikes[/h2]
Ugly creatures, insubordination, sour candies

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/c59099ae76792f52ec18106842b1ba84c38a90ed.png[/img]

Nyanko is an young and powerful wizard with the affinity to summon and control all sorts of creatures from the most different places and dimensions. She loves them all equally and if they don’t love her back, she just force them to!

We wanted to add to the game an homage to JRPGs and anime, so we thought that a Magical Girl kind of character would be a very interesting and funny idea to implement. It would be a different style of character from the others so far, but that still fits very consistently on the roster.

For the theme and also to diversify from the other characters, we opted to make a small, cute and youthful character. Aside from those characteristics, we still wanted for her to be as evil as all the other ones, and we hope we could pass these feeling on the spell cards where she is featured.

We used traditional Japanese clothing as reference to design her dress and accessories. Her main color is pink to exalt her cuteness and to give a false sense of harmlessness on her character, as we described before. We think this duality works really well with the comic mood of the game.

notes.title: Wizard Spotlight: The Necromancer
notes.notes:
[h1]Xarg, The Necromancer[/h1]

Using his death magic to raise zombies, skeletons and ghouls, he intend to conquer the realms with his army of tireless and relentless soldiers. Many a peasant who dared voice their opinion against his music later became an undying fan.

[h2]Likes[/h2]
Unrestricted power, death metal, cheap labor

[h2]Dislikes[/h2]
Healers, gospel music, crematories

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/b75e99c4b4a3d56a5b14c50697d1a148a2921b82.png[/img]

Xarg just wanted to be a singer, but his detractors said he had no talent for that… he then studied the dark necromantic arts for years and came back to change their mind. And that’s how he got his first fans.

We knew that adding a necromancer to the roster was a must, a wizard that deals with the forces of (un)death is a classic villain archetype. And to go with this theme his appearance is cadaveric and rigid, with lines straight out of a coffin.

As fans of heavy metal we also thought it would be funny to have a necromancer that likes death metal, and what started as kind of a joke served to flesh out more his personality and spells.

For the colors, we went with dark colors for his clothes to relate it with the dark arts mastered by him. To contrast with those dark colors, we used light tones for his skin and hair. Aside from the contrast, it also worked well by reinforcing the cadaveric appearance. For his spells, we choose a spectral green to act as a highlight from his sober color scheme.

notes.title: Master of the Wizards Early Access!
notes.notes:
The prophecy was written and it's finally coming true! On the 11th of March, we are releasing the Early Access version of Master of the Wizards at Steam! On this date, you'll be able to check the current version of the game with the following features:

- Choose any one of the playable wizards
- AI with different personalities
- LAN mode available

Besides playing, you can also discuss with us about the game, giving your feedback and opinions, so we can make the better and most fun experience possible for all the wizards around the world!

At the moment, we are working to implement an online playmode and the signature spells for each wizard, but we can give more details about that in the future. You also can check this news on [url=https://monobeetle.com/2022/03/08/master-of-the-wizards-early-access]our website[/url] to get more information about the game and its development.

Stay tuned for more information and we hope to see you partying like a wizards on the 11th of March!

notes.title: Wizard Spotlight: The Witch
notes.notes:
[h1]Evilra, The Witch[/h1]

An ancient (don't say it to her face!) master of curses and dark arts, she uses her wit and cunning on her path to greater power. In her arsenal of potions and obscure resources, she can always find a way to achieve what she wants, whatever it takes... usually for others.

[h2]Likes[/h2]
Unstoppable power, cats, causing misfortunes

[h2]Dislikes[/h2]
Probably you, mobs of peasants, sunny days

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/ac56b249ac0efa9771c6c01a7dafa386d8f7b99d.png[/img]

As a wizard battle game, we couldn’t let a Witch out of the party! The main idea for this character was to create a witty, cunning and empowered goth spellcaster, and with that in mind, we’ve made Evilra!

We wanted to give her an impression of a moving shadow/darkness in the general look, so we picked black as her main color, using it on her dress and hair. As the draw lines are also black, we choose to paint grey the black intersections, so it would be easier to understand the dark masses around the character.

To contrast with all the darkness, we picked a pale skin tone and a red lipstick to giver her face a focus point. We also choose to dress her with a purple corset. Aside from style, it also helps to break the character into more understandable pieces to avoid a boring totally black figure. The cut on the lower part of her dress also serves from the same purpose.

notes.title: Wizard Spotlight: The Druid
notes.notes:
[h1]Grurrr, The Druid[/h1]

As a nature lover, he roams the wilds in search of powerful foes to test his might, for since his childhood he thinks humans are puny opponents. Once a badger bit his head on a confrontation. He wears it to this day to prove his incredible resistance.

[h2]Likes[/h2]
Innate power, nature, punching strong animals

[h2]Dislikes[/h2]
Weak nature, crowds of people, cute animals

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/8ef7fe3000a0278bcb5c3451c25cae0b810ab79b.png[/img]

Grurrr is gruff, wild and smelly. He aspires to be the an apex predator and acts like one. This was the initial concept idea we had from him and so we could make some choices for his appearance.

As he fights many wild beast, Grurrr is very bulky and physically strong, unlike the other wizards. To create a more interesting and funny character, we diverted from the “hippie druid” path: Grurrr says he loves nature, but he doesn’t seem to treat it very well. We tried to represent this feature on his clothing, like using a pair of dead squirrels for slippers.

Grurrr also keeps a live voracious badger stuck on his head as a feat of resistance and strength. We thought it would be a funny twist of the animal fur cloak used by the typical wild and brute character.

notes.title: Wizard Spotlight: The Pyromancer
notes.notes:
[h1]Helliana, The Pyromancer[/h1]

A very powerful, passionate and warm-blooded magic user, she can cast an infinity of miscellaneous spells like fireballs, firebolts, firestorms, walls of fire and a thousand more. Her repertoire is quite enviable.

[h2]Likes[/h2]
Unquenchable power, hot baths, fireworks

[h2]Dislikes[/h2]
Thinking before acting, ice cream, being told to chill

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/2423805167a03507d655e0015d5a708aaf4a6cf9.png[/img]

We wanted to make a reckless, “act before you think” character for the game, so we thought a pyromancer would be a great addition. With this initial concept, we designed Helliana!

Helliana is a impulsive and hotheaded pyromancer. Since her powers and personality matches, we opted to use warm colors on her color scheme to easily show those characteristics.

Although she possess a great magic control (only when she wants to), we gave her a blacksmith inspired outfit to protect her from her own fire spells.

notes.title: Wizard Spotlight: The Scholar
notes.notes:
[h1]Fumbledolphus, The Scholar[/h1]

Holder of an IQ of 382, he is the most knowledgeable Wizard of all (by his own account), writer of thousands of tomes on magic theory, and founder of the great Academy of Arcane Arts. He keeps lots of secrets under his beard and robe.

[h2]Likes[/h2]
Unlimited power, riddles, being right about everything

[h2]Dislikes[/h2]
Unreasonableness, greasy hands, losing an argument

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41044235/c9fb5443500d279e7a8709c43f59510fd7bd870e.png[/img]

The main idea for Fumbledolphus creation was the common pop culture wizard: a wise, old and powerful spellcaster with a pompous name and a magnificent beard.

We chose to make him with a long cloak and beard to build a mysterious aura to the character and, to take advantage of this detail, we thought it would be funny if his hands went through his beard. We’ll have more exciting details about all wizards soon! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Master of the Wizards Official Soundtrack
notes.notes:
Ready to take on a magic and epic auditive journey? Then check out the official Master of the Wizards soundtrack right now! From serene and appeasing melodies to chaotic and monumental tunes, you can experience the dangers and challenges of a wizard's battle with your own ears!

notes.title: RETURN OF PARTY LIKE A WIZARD RETURNS!!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Wizards!

The time of prophecy draws ever closer. The Master of the Wizards is gone, the multiverse lies in disarray, and you know what that means?? It means the position is open and YOU can take the place of the old geezer!!

So join us as we explain the "rules" and answer all your questions about this chaotic contest of magical skill between the most powerful, evil and mad Wizards!

Grab some snacks and tune in your liquid crystal balls and scrying panels to watch this demonstration. Then you will be ready to face the challenge yourself and battle your friends to become the Master of the Wizards.
